name: Caiaphas
title: High Priest
summary: Joseph Caiaphas was the high priest in Jerusalem from about 18–36 AD. He led the trial of Jesus and said it was better that one man should die for the people. Without knowing it, he thus prophesied about Jesus' atoning death. He also led the persecution of the apostles in the early church.

keyEvents.title: Prophecy About Jesus' Death
keyEvents.description: Caiaphas said it was better that one man should die for the people—an unconscious prophecy.

keyEvents.title: The Trial of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Caiaphas led the trial of Jesus and asked him to swear whether he was the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Sent Jesus to Pilate
keyEvents.description: After the trial, Caiaphas sent Jesus to Pilate to obtain a death sentence.

keyEvents.title: Persecution of the Apostles
keyEvents.description: Caiaphas presided over the hearing of Peter and John after the healing at the temple.
